analogy.rationale: HMGCR inhibitors block the mevalonate pathway, and sterol demethylase inhibitors act in the same cholesterol biosynthesis cascade, producing the most similar transcriptional response; downstream sterol-sensing nuclear receptors (FXR, LXR, PPAR) and lipid synthesis enzymes are also expected to respond similarly.
